rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY,
  addr.STATE,
  addr.POSTAL_CODE
FROM fclt_organization fo
JOIN fclt_building b
  ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
    OR fo.ORGANIZATION = b.BUILDING_NAME
    OR fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME

  ON addr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND addr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_key_dates AS (
  SELECT
    `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_START_DATE`,
    `TERM_END_DATE`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION`
  FROM `academic_terms`
),
-- iap_subject_detail holds activity info; iap_subject_person holds persons (including Activity leader)
iap_detail_person AS (
  SELECT
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY`,
    d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    d.`TERM_CODE`,
    d.`ENROLLMENT_TYPE`,
    p.`PERSON_NAME`,
    p.`PERSON_ROLE`,
    d.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` d
  LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_person` p
    ON d.`IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY` = p.`IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY`
),
-- session info to get location/date if available
iap_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    `SESSION_TITLE`,
    `SESSION_LOCATION`,
    `SESSION_DATE`,
    `SESSION_START_TIME`,
    `SESSION_END_TIME`,
    `SESSION_SEQUENCE`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `iap_subject_session`
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  TRIM(d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`) AS ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  NULLIF(TRIM(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`), '') AS MEET_PLACE,
  TRIM(t.`TERM_START_DATE`) AS TERM_START_DATE,
  TRIM(d.`PERSON_NAME`) AS SUPERVISOR_NAME
FROM iap_detail_person d
LEFT JOIN iap_sessions s
  ON d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` = s.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`
LEFT JOIN term_key_dates t
  ON d.`TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE`
WHERE
  -- only independent activities: assume indicated by ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'independent' or ACTIVITY_TITLE containing 'independent'
  (
    LOWER(TRIM(d.`ENROLLMENT_TYPE`)) = 'independent'
    OR LOWER(TRIM(d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`)) LIKE '%independent%'
  )
  -- only activity leaders as supervisors
  AND LOWER(TRIM(d.`PERSON_ROLE`)) = 'activity leader'
  -- exclude null/empty activity title and term start date
  AND d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(d.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`) <> ''
  AND t.`TERM_START_DATE` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.`TERM_START_DATE`) <> ''
ORDER BY t.`TERM_START_DATE` ASC

rows.question: What is the room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of Professor Summer Haynes's office?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  eop.parsed_room AS ROOM,
  eop.parsed_floor AS FLOOR,
  bl.BUILDING_KEY,
  -- prefer the canonical building street address from buildings; fall back to fac_building_address composed pieces
  CASE
    WHEN bl.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(bl.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) <> '' THEN bl.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS
    ELSE CONCAT_WS(' ',
           NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_NUMBER), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_NAME), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(fba.STREET_SUFFIX), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL), '')
         )
  END AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM (
  -- minimal employee fetch by full name
  SELECT MIT_ID, FULL_NAME, OFFICE_LOCATION
  FROM drupal_employee_directory
  WHERE FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
) ed
-- parse office location into room / floor / building number heuristically
JOIN (
  SELECT
    d.MIT_ID,
    d.OFFICE_LOCATION,
    d.FULL_NAME,
    TRIM(
      NULLIF(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.OFFICE_LOCATION, ' / ', -1),
          ',', 1
        ),
        ''
      )
    ) AS parsed_room,
    TRIM(
      NULLIF(
        CASE
          WHEN INSTR(d.OFFICE_LOCATION, ' / ') > 0 THEN
            NULLIF(
              SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.OFFICE_LOCATION, ' / ', -2),
                ' / ',
                1
              ),
              ''
            )
          ELSE NULL
        END,
        ''
      )
    ) AS parsed_floor,
    TRIM(
      NULLIF(
        CASE
          WHEN d.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL THEN NULL
          ELSE
            NULLIF(
              SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.OFFICE_LOCATION, ',', 1),
                ' / ',
                1
              ),
              ''
            )
        END,
        ''
      )
    ) AS parsed_building_number
  FROM drupal_employee_directory d
  WHERE d.FULL_NAME = 'Haynes, Summer'
) eop ON ed.MIT_ID = eop.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN buildings bl
  -- join by building number parsed from office_location to buildings.BUILDING_NUMBER (most common mapping)
  ON eop.parsed_building_number IS NOT NULL
     AND eop.parsed_building_number = bl.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON bl.BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LIMIT 1

rows.question: List the unique full room names, their corresponding building names, street addresses, cities, states, postal codes, and building heights for rooms associated with subjects that Computer Science students can enroll in.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS FULL_ROOM_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  CASE
    WHEN fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
         AND (fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '') THEN
      TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
        NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''),
        NULLIF(fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL, ''),
        NULLIF(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
        NULLIF(fba.STREET_SUFFIX, ''),
        NULLIF(fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL, '')
      ))
    ELSE b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS
  END AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  COALESCE(fba.CITY, '') AS CITY,
  COALESCE(fba.STATE, '') AS STATE,
  COALESCE(fba.POSTAL_CODE, '') AS POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccs
JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
  ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID
JOIN subject_offered so
  ON so.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY = sos.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY
  AND so.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  -- match the meeting place against the room identifiers present in fac_rooms:
  ON so.MEET_PLACE = fr.ROOM
  OR so.MEET_PLACE = fr.BUILDING_ROOM
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  -- fac_rooms has BUILDING_KEY which corresponds to buildings.BUILDING_NUMBER per schema naming
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = fr.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fba.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
WHERE ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH section_enrollment_counts AS (
  SELECT
    so.SECTION_ID,
    so.TERM_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.MEET_PLACE,
    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CAST(so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS SIGNED), 0) AS ENROLLED,
    so.IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
    so.IS_LAB_SECTION,
    so.IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
    so.IS_DESIGN_SECTION
  FROM subject_offered so
  WHERE so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
course_section_offerings_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    sec.SECTION_ID,
    sec.TERM_CODE,
    sec.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    sec.MEET_PLACE,
    CASE
      WHEN sec.IS_LECTURE_SECTION IN ('1','t','T','true','TRUE','Y','y','yes','YES') THEN 1
      WHEN sec.IS_LECTURE_SECTION IS NULL OR TRIM(sec.IS_LECTURE_SECTION) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE 0
    END AS IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
    CASE
      WHEN sec.IS_LAB_SECTION IN ('1','t','T','true','TRUE','Y','y','yes','YES') THEN 1
      WHEN sec.IS_LAB_SECTION IS NULL OR TRIM(sec.IS_LAB_SECTION) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE 0
    END AS IS_LAB_SECTION,
    CASE
      WHEN sec.IS_RECITATION_SECTION IN ('1','t','T','true','TRUE','Y','y','yes','YES') THEN 1
      WHEN sec.IS_RECITATION_SECTION IS NULL OR TRIM(sec.IS_RECITATION_SECTION) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE 0
    END AS IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
    CASE
      WHEN sec.IS_DESIGN_SECTION IN ('1','t','T','true','TRUE','Y','y','yes','YES') THEN 1
      WHEN sec.IS_DESIGN_SECTION IS NULL OR TRIM(sec.IS_DESIGN_SECTION) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE 0
    END AS IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
    sec.ENROLLED
  FROM section_enrollment_counts sec
)
SELECT
  c.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  c.MEET_PLACE AS ROOM,
  fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  -- use fac_building fields; SITE often holds street info in this schema
  fb.SITE AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  -- city/state/postal stored inconsistently in schema; fac_building has limited fields.
  -- attempt to use BUILDING_NAME_LONG as CITY and BUILDING_SORT as STATE, and NULL postal if not present.
  fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS CITY,
  fb.BUILDING_SORT AS STATE,
  NULL AS POSTAL_CODE,
  TRIM(
    CONCAT_WS(', ',
      CASE WHEN c.IS_LECTURE_SECTION = 1 THEN 'Lecture' END,
      CASE WHEN c.IS_LAB_SECTION = 1 THEN 'Lab' END,
      CASE WHEN c.IS_RECITATION_SECTION = 1 THEN 'Recitation' END,
      CASE WHEN c.IS_DESIGN_SECTION = 1 THEN 'Design' END
    )
  ) AS FORMATS,
  c.ENROLLED AS ENROLLED
FROM course_section_offerings_normalized c
JOIN fac_rooms fr
  -- join heuristics: MEET_PLACE may match ROOM, ROOM_FULL_NAME, or SPACE_ID
  ON ( (fr.ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM = c.MEET_PLACE)
       OR (fr.SPACE_ID IS NOT NULL AND fr.SPACE_ID = c.MEET_PLACE)
       OR (fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME = c.MEET_PLACE) )
JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fr.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE
  c.ENROLLED > 300
  AND c.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  AND c.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.FLOOR IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND fb.SITE IS NOT NULL
  AND fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG IS NOT NULL
  AND fb.BUILDING_SORT IS NOT NULL

rows.question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS BUILDING_NAME,
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fb.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) AS YEAR_BUILT,
  COUNT(ed.MIT_ID) AS EMPLOYEE_COUNT
FROM fac_building fb
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE
  fb.DATE_BUILT IS NOT NULL
  AND fb.DATE_BUILT <> ''
  -- ensure DATE_BUILT follows %m/%d/%Y by checking that the year part is numeric of length 4
  AND LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fb.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1)) = 4
  AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(fb.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$'
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fb.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED) < 1950
GROUP BY
  fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG,
  CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(fb.DATE_BUILT, '/', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
HAVING
  COUNT(ed.MIT_ID) > 100

rows.question: For each IAP category and academic year, list the category name, academic year, total fee collected, total number of IAP subjects, and the minimum and maximum enrollment.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  cco.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  cco.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.FEE),''), 0) + 0) AS TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cco.SUBJECT_ID) AS TOTAL_IAP_SUBJECTS,
  MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
  MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cco
LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
  -- iap_subject_detail contains TERM_CODE and represents IAP activities;
  -- join when the course_catalog subject is offered in IAP (EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE or TERM_CODE)
  ON d.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
     OR d.TERM_CODE = cco.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  -- Only include records that indicate IAP offering.
  (cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y' OR cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP = '1' OR UPPER(cco.IS_OFFERED_IAP) = 'TRUE')
  -- Exclude rows with NULL category name or academic year
  AND cco.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC IS NOT NULL
  AND cco.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  cco.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  cco.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  CATEGORY_NAME ASC,
  ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC

rows.question: For each sponsor of the independent activity periods, list the sponsor name, number of sessions held, the total number of enrollment, the minimum and maximum fee, the number of sessions with info, and the number of sessions without info.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH session_level AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    s.SPONSOR_NAME,
    sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY AS session_id,
    -- a session may have multiple detail rows; treat enrollment as sum of MAX_ENROLLMENT per detail for that session
    COALESCE(SUM(det.MAX_ENROLLMENT),0) AS session_enrollment,
    -- fees per session: consider MIN and MAX across detail rows (NULLs are ignored by MIN/MAX)
    MIN(det.FEE) AS session_min_fee,
    MAX(det.FEE) AS session_max_fee,
    -- if session row present use its HAS_SESSION_INFO, otherwise if absent check any detail rows' info via session join;
    -- prefer session.HAS_SESSION_INFO when present
    CASE
      WHEN sess.HAS_SESSION_INFO IS NOT NULL THEN UPPER(TRIM(sess.HAS_SESSION_INFO))
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS has_session_info_flag
  FROM iap_subject_sponsor s
  JOIN iap_subject_detail det
    ON det.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session sess
    ON sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = det.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  GROUP BY
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    s.SPONSOR_NAME,
    sess.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    sess.HAS_SESSION_INFO
),
sponsor_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    SPONSOR_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS number_of_sessions_held,
    SUM(session_enrollment) AS total_enrollment,
    MIN(session_min_fee) AS minimum_fee,
    MAX(session_max_fee) AS maximum_fee,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_session_info_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_with_info,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_session_info_flag <> 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions_without_info
  FROM session_level
  GROUP BY
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    SPONSOR_NAME
)
SELECT
  SPONSOR_NAME AS sponsor_name,
  number_of_sessions_held,
  total_enrollment,
  minimum_fee,
  maximum_fee,
  sessions_with_info,
  sessions_without_info
FROM sponsor_aggregates
WHERE SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND SPONSOR_NAME <> ''
ORDER BY SPONSOR_NAME

rows.question: What are the individual's email and name, academic year, total number of IAP subjects, the minimum and maximum fees, and the total course enrollment for each individual and academic year?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH employee_directory_person AS (
  SELECT
    d.`MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
    d.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` AS `EMAIL_ADDRESS`,
    d.`FULL_NAME` AS `FULL_NAME`,
    d.`FIRST_NAME` AS `FIRST_NAME`,
    d.`LAST_NAME` AS `LAST_NAME`
  FROM `drupal_employee_directory` d
  WHERE d.`MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND d.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` IS NOT NULL
),
-- use course_catalog_subject_offered as the course/subject source (has ACADEMIC_YEAR, IS_OFFERED_IAP, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, maybe FEE not present)
courses AS (
  SELECT
    c.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
    c.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    c.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    c.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    c.`IS_OFFERED_IAP` AS IS_OFFERED_IAP,
    c.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    -- try to use any fee-like column if present; course_catalog_subject_offered has no numeric fee column in the schema.
    NULLIF(NULL, '') AS FEE,
    -- course enrollment not present in course_catalog_subject_offered; try other tables (iap_subject_detail has MAX_ENROLLMENT and FEE)
    c.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` c
),
iap_details AS (
  -- iap_subject_detail contains FEE and MAX_ENROLLMENT per activity/subject per term
  SELECT
    d.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    d.`ENROLLMENT_TYPE` AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE,
    d.`MAX_ENROLLMENT` AS MAX_ENROLLMENT,
    d.`FEE` AS FEE,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` IS NOT NULL AS HAS_SESSION_KEY,
    d.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` d
),
-- join iap detail to course rows by TERM_CODE (and later by academic year via academic_terms)
term_year AS (
  -- map TERM_CODE to ACADEMIC_YEAR
  SELECT
    at.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR
  FROM `academic_terms` at
),
-- combine course rows with iap detail by term to pick up fees and enrollment where available
course_iap_combined AS (
  SELECT
    c.SECTION_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ty.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    c.IS_OFFERED_IAP,
    c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    id.FEE,
    id.MAX_ENROLLMENT
  FROM courses c
  LEFT JOIN term_year ty
    ON c.TERM_CODE = ty.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN iap_details id
    ON c.TERM_CODE = id.TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  edp.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  COALESCE(edp.FULL_NAME, CONCAT_WS(' ', edp.FIRST_NAME, edp.LAST_NAME)) AS FULL_NAME,
  cic.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  -- count distinct subjects (subject_id or subject_code) offered in IAP for the person and academic year
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN UPPER(cic.IS_OFFERED_IAP) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE') THEN COALESCE(cic.SUBJECT_ID, cic.SUBJECT_CODE) END) AS IAP_SUBJECT_COUNT,
  -- min/max fee from joined iap detail (may be NULL if not available)
  MIN(cic.FEE) AS MIN_FEE,
  MAX(cic.FEE) AS MAX_FEE,
  -- total enrollment: sum of MAX_ENROLLMENT where available; if not available will be NULL
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN cic.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL THEN cic.MAX_ENROLLMENT ELSE 0 END) = 0
         AND SUM(CASE WHEN cic.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
      THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN cic.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NOT NULL THEN cic.MAX_ENROLLMENT ELSE 0 END)
  END AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT
FROM course_iap_combined cic
JOIN employee_directory_person edp
  ON cic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = edp.MIT_ID
-- exclude rows where we cannot determine academic year
WHERE cic.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  edp.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  FULL_NAME,
  cic.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  FULL_NAME ASC,

    ELSE 0

    END

  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN s.has_parsible_time = 1 AND s.parsed_start_time IS NOT NULL AND s.parsed_end_time IS NOT NULL
      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,
           STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT('2000-01-01 ', s.parsed_start_time), '%Y-%m-%d %h:%i%p'),

rows.question: What is total number of subjects, the total fee, and the shortest and longest sessions, for all virtual IAP sessions?

WITH iap_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    ccsf.SECTION_ID,
    ccsf.SUBJECT_ID,
    ccsf.TERM_DURATION,
    ccsf.MEET_TIME,
    ccsf.MEET_PLACE,
    NULLIF(TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN ccsf.MEET_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(ccsf.MEET_TIME, '-', 1)
        WHEN ccsf.MEET_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2} ?[aApP][mM]' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(ccsf.MEET_TIME, '-', 1)
        ELSE ''
      END
    ), '') AS SESSION_START_TIME_RAW,
    NULLIF(TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN ccsf.MEET_TIME REGEXP '-[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(ccsf.MEET_TIME, '-', -1)
        WHEN ccsf.MEET_TIME REGEXP '-[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2} ?[aApP][mM]' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(ccsf.MEET_TIME, '-', -1)
        ELSE ''
      END
    ), '') AS SESSION_END_TIME_RAW,
    ccsf.TERM_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS ccsf
  WHERE ccsf.TERM_DURATION IS NOT NULL
    AND UPPER(ccsf.TERM_DURATION) LIKE '%IAP%'
),
iap_sessions_with_fee AS (
  -- aggregate any fees from tip_detail per TERM_CODE+SUBJECT_ID
  SELECT
    s.SECTION_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.TERM_DURATION,
    s.MEET_TIME,
    s.MEET_PLACE,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME_RAW,
    s.SESSION_END_TIME_RAW,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(td.FEE,0)), 0) AS TOTAL_FEE,
    s.TERM_CODE
  FROM iap_sessions s
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail td
    ON td.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
   AND td.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY
    s.SECTION_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.TERM_DURATION,
    s.MEET_TIME,
    s.MEET_PLACE,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME_RAW,
    s.SESSION_END_TIME_RAW,
    s.TERM_CODE
),
-- prefer precise schedule from subject_iap_schedule when available
iap_times AS (
  SELECT
    s.SECTION_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.TERM_DURATION,
    NULLIF(TRIM(iaps.MEET_START_TIME), '') AS MEET_START_TIME,
    NULLIF(TRIM(iaps.MEET_END_TIME), '') AS MEET_END_TIME,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME_RAW,
    s.SESSION_END_TIME_RAW,
    s.MEET_PLACE,
    s.TOTAL_FEE,
    s.TERM_CODE
  FROM iap_sessions_with_fee s
  LEFT JOIN subject_iap_schedule iaps
    ON iaps.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
   AND iaps.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- normalize various time formats into TIME
parsed_times AS (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    TERM_DURATION,
    MEET_PLACE,
    TOTAL_FEE AS FEE,
    COALESCE(MEET_START_TIME, SESSION_START_TIME_RAW) AS SESSION_START_TIME,
    COALESCE(MEET_END_TIME, SESSION_END_TIME_RAW) AS SESSION_END_TIME
  FROM iap_times
),
normalized_times AS (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    TERM_DURATION,
    MEET_PLACE,
    FEE,
    -- normalize start
    CASE
      WHEN SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}[[:space:]]*[aApP][mM]$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%l:%i %p')
      WHEN SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%H:%i')
      WHEN SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{3,4}[[:space:]]*[aApP][mM]$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%p')
      WHEN SESSION_START_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]*[aApP][mM]$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%l %p')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS SESSION_START_TIME_PARSED,
    -- normalize end
    CASE
      WHEN SESSION_END_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}[[:space:]]*[aApP][mM]$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%l:%i %p')
      WHEN SESSION_END_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2}$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%H:%i')
      WHEN SESSION_END_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{3,4}[[:space:]]*[aApP][mM]$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%p')
      WHEN SESSION_END_TIME REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]*[aApP][mM]$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%l %p')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS SESSION_END_TIME_PARSED
  FROM parsed_times
),
virtual_iap AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM normalized_times
  WHERE (
      LOWER(COALESCE(MEET_PLACE, '')) LIKE '%virtual%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(MEET_PLACE, '')) LIKE '%online%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(MEET_PLACE, '')) LIKE '%zoom%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(MEET_PLACE, '')) LIKE '%remote%'
    )
    AND SESSION_START_TIME_PARSED IS NOT NULL
    AND SESSION_END_TIME_PARSED IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  COALESCE(SUM(FEE),0) AS total_fee,
  MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, SESSION_START_TIME_PARSED, SESSION_END_TIME_PARSED)) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, SESSION_START_TIME_PARSED, SESSION_END_TIME_PARSED)) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM virtual_iap

  UNION DISTINCT

    NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULLIF(SUBJECT_ID, '') AS SUBJECT_ID,
    NULLIF(SUBJECT_NUMBER, '') AS SUBJECT_NUMBER

    NULLIF(DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULLIF(SUBJECT_ID, '') AS SUBJECT_ID,
    NULLIF(SUBJECT_NUMBER, '') AS SUBJECT_NUMBER
  FROM cis_course_catalog

  FROM (
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
    UNION

    UNION

  ) d

  -- prefer gross square footage, fall back to assignable, else 0

  -- sum building heights where available; treat non-numeric as 0 via CAST when possible
  COALESCE(building_heights.TOTAL_BUILDING_HEIGHT, 0) AS TOTAL_BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM master_dept_hierarchy m

  SELECT

  FROM fac_rooms fr

    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
)

  COALESCE(c.room_full_name, r.ROOM_FULL_NAME, CONCAT_WS(' ', r.BUILDING_NAME, r.ROOM_NUMBER)) AS room_full_name,
  r.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  r.FLOOR_NUMBER AS floor_number,
  r.ORGANIZATION AS occupying_organization,

  COALESCE(c.room_area, r.ROOM_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, r.ROOM_NET_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS room_area,

WITH buildings_base_77 AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER

    AND `BUILDING_NAME` IS NOT NULL

  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH ', ' FROM CONCAT_WS(', ',
     fr.orgs,
     frl.orgs,
     sd.orgs
  )), '') AS DEPARTMENT_OR_ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  GREATEST(
    COALESCE(fr.max_floor, -99999),
    COALESCE(frl.max_floor, -99999),
    COALESCE(sd.max_floor, -99999)
  ) AS HIGHEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,

    COALESCE(fr.min_floor,  99999),
    COALESCE(frl.min_floor, 99999),
    COALESCE(sd.min_floor, 99999)
  ) AS LOWEST_FLOOR_NUMBER,

    `BUILDING_KEY`,

    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(`FLOOR`, '') AS SIGNED)) AS min_floor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(`ROOM`, '')) AS room_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(`ORGANIZATION_NAME`, '') SEPARATOR ', ') AS orgs

  WHERE `BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `BUILDING_KEY`

    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(`FLOOR`, '') AS SIGNED)) AS max_floor,

  WHERE `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`

  SELECT

  GROUP BY `BUILDING_KEY`

rows.question: What is the total number of library materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of materials status for each course name?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  COALESCE(m.total_materials, 0) AS total_materials,
  m.min_publication_year,
  m.max_publication_year,
  m.materials_status_counts
FROM (
  SELECT
    cso.SUBJECT_ID,
    cso.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    cso.SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS cso
  WHERE cso.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(cso.SUBJECT_TITLE) <> ''
) c
LEFT JOIN (
  /* aggregate library reserve items per subject */
  SELECT
    lrmd.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(lrmd.cnt_per_catalog) AS total_materials,
    MIN(years.year_int) AS min_publication_year,
    MAX(years.year_int) AS max_publication_year,
    /* produce status -> count mapping as comma-separated "status:count" pairs */
    GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(sc.status_label, ':', sc.status_count) ORDER BY sc.status_label SEPARATOR ',') AS materials_status_counts
  FROM (
    /* first aggregate by SUBJECT_ID + LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY + LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
       to avoid duplicating when joining to catalog/status */
    SELECT
      lr.SUBJECT_ID,
      lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
      lr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt_per_catalog
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lr
    WHERE lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) <> ''
    GROUP BY lr.SUBJECT_ID, lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  ) lrmd
  LEFT JOIN (
    /* extract numeric year when possible */
    SELECT
      LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
      CASE WHEN CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(CATALOG_YEAR AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS year_int
    FROM library_reserve_catalog
  ) years
    ON years.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  /* compute status counts per subject by joining to a derived table that sums cnt_per_catalog per subject+status */
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      t.SUBJECT_ID,
      t.status_label,
      SUM(t.cnt_per_catalog) AS status_count
    FROM (
      SELECT
        lr3.SUBJECT_ID,
        COALESCE(lms3.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'UNKNOWN') AS status_label,
        lr3.cnt_per_catalog
      FROM (
        SELECT
          lr.SUBJECT_ID,
          lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
          lr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
          COUNT(*) AS cnt_per_catalog
        FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lr
        WHERE lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) <> ''
        GROUP BY lr.SUBJECT_ID, lr.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
      ) lr3
      LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms3
        ON lms3.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lr3.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    ) t
    GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, t.status_label
  ) sc
    ON sc.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
  GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
) m
  ON m.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ASC

    sd.`BUILDING_KEY`,

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.

WITH list_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS member_count
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail mld
    ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  GROUP BY
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    ml.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC,
    ml.IS_HIDDEN
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(member_count) AS max_members,
    MIN(member_count) AS min_members
  FROM list_counts
)
SELECT
  lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  lc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER,
  lc.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST,
  lc.IS_PUBLIC,
  lc.IS_HIDDEN,
  lc.member_count
FROM list_counts lc
JOIN extremes e
  ON lc.member_count = e.max_members
  OR lc.member_count = e.min_members
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner mlo
  ON mlo.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
ORDER BY
  lc.member_count DESC,
  lc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.

WITH
faculty_summer AS (
  -- list of faculty identifiers (MIT_ID) or names who taught in any summer term after FY 2001
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL AND so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` <> ''
        THEN so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
      WHEN so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` <> ''
        THEN so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`
      ELSE NULL
    END AS faculty_member_key
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered so
  JOIN time_quarter tq
    ON so.`TERM_CODE` = tq.`FY_QUARTER_CODE`
  WHERE so.`TERM_CODE` LIKE '%SU' -- TERM_CODE formatted like 'YYYYTT', with 'SU' for summer
    AND CAST(tq.`FISCAL_YEAR` AS SIGNED) > 2001
    -- also allow if fiscal year stored in different column; if FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR exists in your time table, use that instead
),
members_with_names AS (
  -- canonical member identifier: prefer MIT_ID where available, otherwise the raw member string
  SELECT
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`,
    mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS member_string,
    d.`FULL_NAME` AS member_full_name
  FROM moira_list_detail mld
  LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory d
    ON mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` = d.`MIT_ID`
  WHERE mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` IS NOT NULL
     OR mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
member_is_faculty AS (
  -- mark whether a given member (by MIT_ID or by member string/name) matches the faculty_summer list
  SELECT
    m.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    -- normalized member id for counting distinct people
    COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, ''), NULLIF(m.member_string, '')) AS member_key,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, ''), NULLIF(m.member_string, '')) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(m.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, ''), NULLIF(m.member_string, '')) IN (
        SELECT faculty_member_key FROM faculty_summer
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_faculty
  FROM members_with_names m
)
SELECT
  ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mi.member_key) AS NUM_PEOPLE,
  SUM(mi.is_faculty) AS NUM_FACULTY_IN_LIST
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON ml.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
-- join to computed member info to get normalized member_key and faculty flag
JOIN member_is_faculty mi
  ON mi.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY` = mld.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
    AND mi.member_key = COALESCE(NULLIF(mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID`, ''), NULLIF(mld.`MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER`, ''))
WHERE ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`) LIKE 'c%' -- names starting with C (case-insensitive)
GROUP BY ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`
ORDER BY ml.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`

rows.question: For each unique mailing list with a name beginning with R (case insensitive), and that Professor Ayden Hopkins is subscribed to, list its name, description, owner, number of people in the list, and number of tenured faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- basic moira list info (carry key for joinability)
ml_basic AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_NAME`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION`,
    `IS_ACTIVE`
  FROM `moira_list`
),
-- list members (carry key/id columns)
ml_members AS (
  SELECT
    `MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER` AS MEMBER_NAME,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME` AS MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
    `MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID` AS MEMBER_MIT_ID
  FROM `moira_list_detail`
),
-- member -> personnel attributes to check payroll rank (left join so non-mit-id members are counted but have NULL rank)
member_person AS (
  SELECT
    mm.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`,
    mm.MEMBER_MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(de.`FULL_NAME`, mm.MEMBER_FULL_NAME, mm.MEMBER_NAME) AS MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
    se.`PAYROLL_RANK`
  FROM ml_members mm
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_employee_directory` de
    ON mm.MEMBER_MIT_ID = de.MIT_ID
  LEFT JOIN `se_person` se
    ON mm.MEMBER_MIT_ID = se.MIT_ID
),
-- lists that include Hopkins, Ayden (matching FULL_NAME in members or in drupal_employee_directory)
lists_with_hopkins AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    mp.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`
  FROM member_person mp
  WHERE mp.MEMBER_FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
     OR mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID IN (
       SELECT MIT_ID FROM drupal_employee_directory WHERE FULL_NAME = 'Hopkins, Ayden'
     )
)
SELECT
  mb.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` AS mailing_list_name,
  mb.`MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION` AS mailing_list_description,
  -- owners: gather distinct owners for the list (may be NULL)
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT mlo.`OWNER` SEPARATOR '; ') AS mailing_list_owner,
  -- total distinct subscribers (count distinct MIT_ID when available, otherwise count distinct member name)
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID <> '' THEN mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID
      ELSE mp.MEMBER_FULL_NAME
    END
  ) AS total_subscribers,
  -- count distinct subscribers whose PAYROLL_RANK = 'Faculty Tenured'
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE WHEN mp.PAYROLL_RANK = 'Faculty Tenured' AND mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID <> ''
         THEN mp.MEMBER_MIT_ID
    END
  ) AS tenured_faculty_subscribers
FROM ml_basic mb
-- only lists that include Hopkins
JOIN lists_with_hopkins lwh
  ON mb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = lwh.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- join members and their person info
LEFT JOIN member_person mp
  ON mb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mp.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
-- join owners via moira_list_owner by owner key present in moira_list_detail
LEFT JOIN `moira_list_detail` mld
  ON mb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN `moira_list_owner` mlo
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
-- filter lists whose name begins with 'R' or 'r' (case-insensitive)
WHERE mb.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(mb.`MOIRA_LIST_NAME`) LIKE 'r%'
GROUP BY
  mb.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  mb.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mb.MOIRA_LIST_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  mb.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

  FROM buildings_base b
  JOIN max_building_counter m ON b.BUILDING_COUNTER = m.max_cnt

    SUM(CASE WHEN tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tip_new_price_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS tip_used_price_sum,
    SUM(CASE WHEN tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tip_used_price_count,
    SUM(IFNULL(td.RECORD_COUNT,0)) AS tip_material_record_count
  FROM `tip_detail` td
  LEFT JOIN `tip_material` tm
    ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- library aggregates per subject via reserve material detail -> catalog (exclude null/empty titles and isbns)
library_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    lrmd.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_TITLE,'')) AS unique_library_titles_per_course,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(lrc.CATALOG_ISBN,'')) AS unique_library_isbns_per_course
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  WHERE lrmd.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- combine course-level info with per-subject aggregates
course_with_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    coc.SUBJECT_ID,
    coc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    coc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
    coc.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    IFNULL(se.course_enrollment,0) AS course_enrollment,
    IFNULL(tip.unique_materials_per_course,0) AS unique_materials_per_course,
    tip.tip_new_price_sum,
    tip.tip_new_price_count,
    tip.tip_used_price_sum,
    tip.tip_used_price_count,
    IFNULL(tip.tip_material_record_count,0) AS tip_material_record_count,
    IFNULL(lib.unique_library_titles_per_course,0) AS unique_library_titles_per_course,
    IFNULL(lib.unique_library_isbns_per_course,0) AS unique_library_isbns_per_course
  FROM course_offerings_core coc
  LEFT JOIN subject_enrollment_per_subject se ON se.SUBJECT_ID = coc.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_aggregates tip ON tip.SUBJECT_ID = coc.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN library_aggregates lib ON lib.SUBJECT_ID = coc.SUBJECT_ID
  -- course_offerings_core already restricted to Department = 'Biology'
)
SELECT
  'Biology' AS department_name,
  cwa.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  cwa.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  -- total enrollments for the group (sum of per-course enrollments)
  SUM(cwa.course_enrollment) AS total_enrollments,
  -- average enrollment within its cluster: average of per-course enrollments within the same cluster_type
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(cwa.course_enrollment) END AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster,
  -- course level derived from SUBJECT_NUMBER: take leading numeric prefix (e.g., '6.01' -> '6' or use full SUBJECT_NUMBER if no leading digits)
  CASE
    WHEN cwa.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN
      SUBSTRING(cwa.SUBJECT_NUMBER, 1, LENGTH(REGEXP_SUBSTR(cwa.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+')))
    ELSE
      cwa.SUBJECT_NUMBER
  END AS course_level,
  -- unique course material identifiers count aggregated across courses in the group
  SUM(cwa.unique_materials_per_course) AS unique_course_material_count,
  -- average TIP new price across materials for the group: sum of material prices divided by count of non-null prices
  CASE WHEN SUM(cwa.tip_new_price_count) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(cwa.tip_new_price_sum) / SUM(cwa.tip_new_price_count)
  END AS avg_tip_new_price,
  CASE WHEN SUM(cwa.tip_used_price_count) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE SUM(cwa.tip_used_price_sum) / SUM(cwa.tip_used_price_count)
  END AS avg_tip_used_price,
  -- total TIP material record count for the group
  SUM(cwa.tip_material_record_count) AS tip_material_record_count,
  -- unique library title and isbn counts aggregated (summing distinct-per-course counts)
  SUM(cwa.unique_library_titles_per_course) AS unique_library_title_count,
  SUM(cwa.unique_library_isbns_per_course) AS unique_library_isbn_count
FROM course_with_aggregates cwa
-- group by cluster type, derived course level, and course title as requested
GROUP BY
  cwa.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  course_level,
  cwa.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY
  total_enrollments DESC,
  cluster_type,
  course_level

  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
exploded_instructors AS (

    il.SCHOOL_NAME,
    il.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    il.SUBJECT_NUMBER,

    il.TERM_CODE,

    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(il.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS_RAW, ',', n.n), ',', -1)), '') AS SPRING_INSTRUCTOR

    ) AS FALL_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
    ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT si.SPRING_INSTRUCTOR)
      FROM exploded_instructors si

WITH

catalog_union AS (

    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS enrollment -- cis_course_catalog doesn't carry enrollment here
  FROM cis_course_catalog c
  WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, ''), NULL) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, ''), NULL) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,

    COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULL) AS SUBJECT_ID,

    cc.TOTAL_UNITS,
    cc.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS enrollment -- course_catalog_subject_offered doesn't have enrollment in schema provided
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc
  WHERE cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, ''), NULL) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC, ''), NULL) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULL, d.SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULL) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(d.SUBJECT_CODE, d.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    d.TOTAL_UNITS,
    d.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS enrollment -- drupal_course_catalog doesn't have enrollment in schema provided

  WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
),
-- If there were section/offerings tables with enrollment counts we'd aggregate them here.
-- Based on provided schema, enrollment for subjects isn't present in the three preferred tables,
-- so total_enrollment will be returned as NULL per instructions.
subjects_dedup AS (
  -- choose a canonical subject key per row: MASTER_SUBJECT_ID if present, else SUBJECT_ID
  SELECT
    HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ''), NULLIF(SUBJECT_ID, '')) AS subj_key,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    TOTAL_UNITS,

SELECT

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.

SELECT
  resolved.RESOLVED_CLUSTER AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
  resolved.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  resolved.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS DEPARTMENT_GRANTS_DEGREES,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS,
  SUM(resolved.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  AVG(resolved.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT) AS AVERAGE_ENROLLMENT
FROM (
  -- derive subject-level enrollment by linking course_catalog_subject_offered to drupal_course_catalog
  -- and preferring enrollment numbers from subject_summary, subject_offered_summary, subject_offered
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_UID,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE, ''),
      NULLIF(dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE, ''), -- dcc has SO_CLUSTER_TYPE; keep consistent
      NULLIF(ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, ''),
      'UNSPECIFIED'
    ) AS RESOLVED_CLUSTER,
    COALESCE(ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- choose school name from subject_summary, then subject_offered_summary, then subject_offered, then drupal, then course_catalog_subject_offered
    COALESCE(ss.SCHOOL_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- prefer subject enrollment from the summary tables, then subject_offered_summary, then subject_offered, else 0
    COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, sos.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT,
    COALESCE(ccso.TERM_CODE, dcc.SO_TERM_CODE, ss.TERM_CODE, sos.TERM_CODE, so.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dcc
    ON ccso.TERM_CODE = dcc.SO_TERM_CODE
    AND COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID) = COALESCE(dcc.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID)
  LEFT JOIN subject_summary ss
    ON COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID) = ss.SUBJECT_ID
    AND COALESCE(ccso.TERM_CODE, dcc.SO_TERM_CODE) = ss.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary sos
    ON COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID) = sos.SUBJECT_ID
    AND COALESCE(ccso.TERM_CODE, dcc.SO_TERM_CODE) = sos.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
    ON COALESCE(ccso.SUBJECT_ID, dcc.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID) = so.SUBJECT_ID
    AND COALESCE(ccso.TERM_CODE, dcc.SO_TERM_CODE) = so.TERM_CODE
) AS resolved
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
  ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = resolved.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE resolved.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT > 0
GROUP BY
  resolved.RESOLVED_CLUSTER,
  resolved.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  resolved.SCHOOL_NAME,
  sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
HAVING SUM(resolved.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT) > 0
ORDER BY TOTAL_ENROLLMENT DESC

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.

SELECT
  agg.meet_place AS room_number,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  NULL AS building_city,
  NULL AS building_state,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS area,
  COALESCE(agg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, agg.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS organization_name,
  NULL AS room_usage,

    ELSE NULL
  END AS course_level,
  agg.total_subjects,
  agg.unique_meet_times,
  agg.total_units
FROM (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    MEET_PLACE AS meet_place,
    EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    MAX(SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    MAX(DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'Unknown') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_TOTAL
FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  -- join subject_offered to the course_catalog_subject_offered by SECTION_ID if available, otherwise by SUBJECT_ID+TERM
  ON (so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SECTION_ID = cs.SECTION_ID)
     OR (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID AND so.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE)
WHERE
  -- only catalog items cataloged on/after 2000-01-01; filter out items without a department name
  lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01'
  AND COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') <> ''
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME

UNION ALL

-- Subtotals per material status
SELECT
  COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_TOTAL
FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
  ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON (so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SECTION_ID = cs.SECTION_ID)
     OR (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID AND so.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE)
WHERE
  lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01'
  AND COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') <> ''
GROUP BY
  lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS

UNION ALL

-- Grand total across all statuses and departments
SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
  'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENT_TOTAL
FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lrmd.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
  ON (so.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SECTION_ID = cs.SECTION_ID)
     OR (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND cs.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID AND so.TERM_CODE = cs.TERM_CODE)
WHERE
  lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01'
  AND COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') <> ''

ORDER BY
  -- Put Grand Total last
  CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  MATERIAL_STATUS ASC,
  -- For each status list departments alphabetically, then the Subtotal row immediately after departments

Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').

WITH library_course_associations_stub AS (
  SELECT
    c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    c.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS c
  WHERE c.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
-- derive enrollment per section from subject_offered_summary (uses SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY rows per section)
section_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    TERM_CODE,
    SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
    SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY AS SECTION_ID, -- carry SECTION_ID name to match joins (no real SECTION_ID in summary; use key)
    NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM subject_offered_summary
  WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
),
dept_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lcas.SECTION_ID) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_items_associated,
    AVG(IFNULL(se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
  FROM library_course_associations_stub AS lcas
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrd
    ON lcas.SUBJECT_ID = lrd.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lcas.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE
  JOIN library_reserve_catalog AS lrc
    ON lrd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN section_enrollment AS se
    -- attempt to match by subject and term; section keys are not consistently present so match by subject+term
    ON lcas.SUBJECT_ID = se.SUBJECT_ID
    AND lcas.TERM_CODE = se.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN sis_department AS d
    ON lcas.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
)

       total_courses_using_library_materials,
       catalog_items_associated,
       avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM dept_aggregates

UNION ALL

  SUM(total_courses_using_library_materials) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
  SUM(catalog_items_associated) AS catalog_items_associated,

  CASE WHEN SUM(total_courses_using_library_materials) = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE SUM(avg_enrollment_per_course * total_courses_using_library_materials) / SUM(total_courses_using_library_materials)
  END AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM dept_aggregates

rows.question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_base AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM `buildings`
),
-- rooms to include (exclude NULL or zero area)
rooms AS (
  SELECT
    fr.`BUILDING_KEY`,
    fr.`FLOOR`,
    fr.`ROOM`,
    fr.`AREA`,
    fr.`ORGANIZATION_NAME`
  FROM `fac_rooms` fr
  WHERE fr.`AREA` IS NOT NULL AND fr.`AREA` <> 0
),
-- building-level totals (sum of included rooms)
building_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA,
    COUNT(*) AS BUILDING_ROOM_COUNT
  FROM rooms r
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- floor-level totals per building
floor_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.FLOOR,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS FLOOR_AREA,
    COUNT(*) AS FLOOR_COUNT
  FROM rooms r
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY, r.FLOOR
),
-- grand total across all buildings (based on included rooms)
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(AREA) AS GRAND_TOTAL_AREA
  FROM rooms
),
-- detail rows + subtotals + building subtotals + grand total, with ordering keys
all_rows AS (
  -- 1) ROOM detail rows
  SELECT
    'ROOM' AS ROW_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    r.FLOOR AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    r.ROOM AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    1 AS NUM_ROOMS,
    ROUND(r.AREA) AS AREA_INT,
    (r.AREA / bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA) * 100.0 AS AREA_PCT,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS sort_building,
    1 AS sort_level,
    r.FLOOR AS sort_floor,
    r.ROOM AS sort_room,
    bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA,
    NULL AS denom_all_buildings
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN buildings_base b ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  JOIN building_totals bt ON bt.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  -- 2) FLOOR subtotals (percent relative to building total)
  SELECT
    'FLOOR_SUBTOTAL' AS ROW_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    ft.FLOOR AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    NULL AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    ft.FLOOR_COUNT AS NUM_ROOMS,
    ROUND(ft.FLOOR_AREA) AS AREA_INT,
    (ft.FLOOR_AREA / bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA) * 100.0 AS AREA_PCT,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS sort_building,
    2 AS sort_level,
    ft.FLOOR AS sort_floor,
    '' AS sort_room,
    bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA,
    NULL AS denom_all_buildings
  FROM floor_totals ft
  JOIN buildings_base b ON ft.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN building_totals bt ON bt.BUILDING_KEY = ft.BUILDING_KEY

  UNION ALL

  -- 3) BUILDING subtotals (percent relative to grand total across all buildings)
  SELECT
    'BUILDING_SUBTOTAL' AS ROW_TYPE,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    NULL AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    NULL AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    bt.BUILDING_ROOM_COUNT AS NUM_ROOMS,
    ROUND(bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA) AS AREA_INT,
    (bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA / gt.GRAND_TOTAL_AREA) * 100.0 AS AREA_PCT,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS sort_building,
    3 AS sort_level,
    NULL AS sort_floor,
    '' AS sort_room,
    bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA,
    gt.GRAND_TOTAL_AREA AS denom_all_buildings
  FROM building_totals bt
  JOIN buildings_base b ON bt.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt

  UNION ALL

  -- 4) GRAND total (percent = 100 relative to grand total)
  SELECT
    'GRAND_TOTAL' AS ROW_TYPE,
    'ALL BUILDINGS' AS BUILDING_NAME,
    NULL AS FLOOR_NUMBER,
    NULL AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    NULL AS OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    SUM(bt.BUILDING_ROOM_COUNT) AS NUM_ROOMS,
    ROUND(SUM(bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA)) AS AREA_INT,
    100.0 AS AREA_PCT,
    'ZZZ' AS sort_building,
    4 AS sort_level,
    NULL AS sort_floor,
    '' AS sort_room,
    SUM(bt.BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA) AS BUILDING_TOTAL_AREA,
    gt.GRAND_TOTAL_AREA AS denom_all_buildings
  FROM building_totals bt
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
)
SELECT
  ROW_TYPE,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  FLOOR_NUMBER,
  ROOM_NUMBER,
  OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  -- format counts and areas with commas, rounding already applied for AREA_INT
  FORMAT(NUM_ROOMS, 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(AREA_INT, 0) AS AREA,
  -- area percentage: rounded to 2 decimals, formatted with two decimals (no thousands sep)
  FORMAT(ROUND(AREA_PCT, 2), 2) AS AREA_PERCENTAGE
FROM all_rows
ORDER BY
  sort_building ASC,
  -- within building: detail rows (1) come first, then floor subtotal (2), then building subtotal (3)
  sort_level ASC,
  -- for detail and floor subtotal ordering by floor (NULLs last)
  CASE WHEN sort_floor IS NULL THEN 'ZZZZZZ' ELSE sort_floor END ASC,
  sort_room ASC

  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(r.room_count) AS building_room_count,
    SUM(r.total_area) AS building_total_area,
    -- average area per room for building: building_total_area / building_room_count
    CASE WHEN SUM(r.room_count) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.total_area) / SUM(r.room_count) END AS building_avg_area_per_room
  FROM rooms_by_building_floor_agg r
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- overall aggregates for grand total
grand_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(r.room_count) AS grand_room_count,
    SUM(r.total_area) AS grand_total_area,
    CASE WHEN SUM(r.room_count) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.total_area) / SUM(r.room_count) END AS grand_avg_area_per_room
  FROM rooms_by_building_floor_agg r
)

SELECT

  r.FLOOR_KEY,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(r.room_count),0),'.00','') AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(r.total_area),0),'.00','') AS TOTAL_AREA,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(r.total_area / NULLIF(r.room_count,0)),0),'.00','') AS AVERAGE_AREA_PER_ROOM,

  -- choose ACCESS_LEVEL from any matching fac_rooms row for that building+floor

   FROM fac_rooms fr
   WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
     AND fr.FLOOR_KEY = r.FLOOR_KEY
     AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
   LIMIT 1) AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  ba.POSTAL_CODE AS ZIP_CODE,
  ba.CITY
FROM rooms_by_building_floor_agg r
JOIN building_basic b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = r.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_address ba ON ba.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

  bagg.BUILDING_KEY,
  'SUBTOTAL' AS FLOOR_KEY,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(bagg.building_room_count),0),'.00','') AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(bagg.building_total_area),0),'.00','') AS TOTAL_AREA,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(bagg.building_avg_area_per_room),0),'.00','') AS AVERAGE_AREA_PER_ROOM,
  bb.BUILDING_NAME,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS ZIP_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS CITY
FROM building_agg bagg
JOIN building_basic bb ON bb.BUILDING_KEY = bagg.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

-- 3) grand total row

  'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_KEY,
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS FLOOR_KEY,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(g.grand_room_count),0),'.00','') AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(g.grand_total_area),0),'.00','') AS TOTAL_AREA,
  REPLACE(FORMAT(ROUND(g.grand_avg_area_per_room),0),'.00','') AS AVERAGE_AREA_PER_ROOM,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS ZIP_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS CITY
FROM grand_agg g

-- Ordering: building name asc, within building floor_key asc, then SUBTOTAL, then GRAND TOTAL last

  -- Ensure grand total last
  CASE
    WHEN BUILDING_KEY = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 3
    WHEN FLOOR_KEY = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2
    ELSE 1

  -- For detail rows, floor sort ascending; keep 'SUBTOTAL' after floors due to CASE above

WITH iap_sessions_by_category_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AS CATEGORY_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
    COALESCE(SUM(CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS UNSIGNED)), 0) AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
    MIN(d.TERM_CODE) AS MIN_TERM_CODE,
    MAX(d.TERM_CODE) AS MAX_TERM_CODE,
    (
      SELECT ss.SPONSOR_NAME
      FROM iap_subject_sponsor ss
      JOIN iap_subject_detail dd ON ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = dd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
      WHERE dd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      GROUP BY ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, ss.SPONSOR_NAME
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
    (
      SELECT s2.SESSION_START_TIME
      FROM iap_subject_session s2
      JOIN iap_subject_detail dd2 ON s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = dd2.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
      WHERE dd2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      GROUP BY s2.SESSION_START_TIME
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.SESSION_START_TIME
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
  FROM iap_subject_category c
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_session s
    ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  WHERE d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY IS NOT NULL OR d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY IS NULL
  GROUP BY c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
)

    ELSE CONCAT(a.MIN_TERM_CODE, '-', a.MAX_TERM_CODE)

  a.MOST_COMMON_START_TIME AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME

Also, include the organization number, level, employer count, and hierarchy type for each organization. Exclude organizations '139' and '250'. WITH organization_canonical_attributes AS (
SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  -- Canonicalize level: prefer ORGANIZATION_LEVEL, fall back to NULL; trim and upper
  NULLIF(TRIM(UPPER(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL)), '') AS LEVEL,
  -- HIERARCHY_TYPE: canonicalize common variants (normalize to upper trimmed)
  NULLIF(TRIM(UPPER(fo.D_CODE)), '') AS HIERARCHY_TYPE,
  -- BREAK_GROUP: preserve if present on fac_organization (not in schema => expose NULL)
  NULL AS BREAK_GROUP,
  -- EMERITUS_STATUS: not stored on fac_organization; expose NULL to keep canonical schema
  NULL AS EMERITUS_STATUS,
  -- FORMATTED_NAME: assemble reusable template pieces based on canonicalized LEVEL.
  -- We produce a single FORMATTED_NAME string that encodes level_based_prefix and level_based_suffix
  -- as "prefix|||suffix" so downstream queries can split. Prefix/suffix chosen by common org levels.
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL)) IN ('SCHOOL','SCHOOL/UNIT','COLLEGE') THEN
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER), ''),''),
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER),''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME), ''),''),
        '|||', -- separator between prefix and suffix
        '' -- suffix empty for school-level (name placed after number)
      )
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL)) IN ('DEPARTMENT','DEPT','DIVISION') THEN
      CONCAT(
        '', -- prefix empty for department-level
        '|||',
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME), ''),'')
      )
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL)) IN ('LAB','CENTER','INSTITUTE') THEN
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME),''),''),
        '|||',
        '' 
      )
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(UPPER(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL)), '') IS NULL THEN
      -- When level unknown, provide ORGANIZATION_NAME as prefix to maximize usability
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME),''),''),
        '|||',
        ''
      )
    ELSE
      -- Default assembly: number followed by name as prefix, empty suffix
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER),''),''),
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER),''),'') <> '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME),''),'') <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME),''),''),
        '|||',
        ''
      )
  END AS FORMATTED_NAME
FROM fac_organization fo
),
organization_employee_rows AS (

  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  -- Build a formatted name but source ORGANIZATION (name) must come from fac_organization; include ORGANIZATION_NUMBER and ORGANIZATION to allow deterministic formatting
  CONCAT(
    COALESCE(fo.ORGANIZATION, ''),
    CASE WHEN fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER <> '' THEN CONCAT(' (', fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER, ')') ELSE '' END

  GROUP BY t.`MOIRA_LIST_KEY`, t.dept_code

rows.question: List the name, number, construction date, and type of all buildings, along with the count of addresses associated with each building, the average gross area of the buildings, and the total number of rooms in each building. Sort the results by building name.

  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  b.DATE_BUILT AS construction_date,
  b.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
  COALESCE(addr_counts.total_address_count, 0) AS address_count,
  AVG(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER () AS average_gross_area,
  COALESCE(b.NUM_OF_ROOMS, b.BUILDING_COUNTER, 0) AS total_rooms
FROM buildings AS b

  SELECT building_key, SUM(addr_count) AS total_address_count
  FROM (

    FROM fclt_building_address
    WHERE FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> ''
    GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

    UNION ALL

    SELECT BUILDING_KEY AS building_key, COUNT(*) AS addr_count
    FROM fac_building_address
    WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND BUILDING_KEY <> ''
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY

    UNION ALL

    -- also count by BUILDING_NUMBER from fclt_building_address (some datasets use number instead of key)
    SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_key, COUNT(*) AS addr_count
    FROM fclt_building_address
    WHERE BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND BUILDING_NUMBER <> ''
    GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER

    UNION ALL

    -- and from fac_building_address if BUILDING_NUMBER exists there
    SELECT POSTAL_CODE /* dummy to match column count */ , 0 /* won't be used */ 
    FROM (SELECT 1) AS x WHERE 1=0
  ) t
  GROUP BY building_key
) addr_counts
  ON addr_counts.building_key = b.BUILDING_KEY
  OR addr_counts.building_key = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> ''

  FROM courses
),
-- instructors: explode possible instructor name lists from known columns.
-- We have RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID and RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME in catalogs,
-- and library_course_instructor.INSTRUCTOR_NAME in library table.
instructors AS (
  -- use MIT id when available
  SELECT
    cc.COURSE_ID,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    TRIM(cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS INSTRUCTOR_ID
  FROM canonical_courses cc
  WHERE cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) <> ''
  UNION
  -- use responsible faculty name when mit id not available
  SELECT
    cc.COURSE_ID,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME), '') AS INSTRUCTOR_ID
  FROM canonical_courses cc
  WHERE (cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID IS NULL OR TRIM(cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) = '')
    AND cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(cc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) <> ''
  UNION
  -- include instructors from library_course_instructor linked to courses by COURSE_NAME = SUBJECT_ID
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(lso.SUBJECT_ID),''), NULLIF(lci.COURSE_NAME,'')) AS COURSE_ID,
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULLIF(TRIM(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME), '') AS INSTRUCTOR_ID
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lci.COURSE_NAME = lso.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> '')
    AND lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME) <> ''
),
-- reserved materials: from library_reserve_matrl_detail linked to library_subject_offered
reserved_materials AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(lso.SUBJECT_ID),''), NULLIF(lrm.SUBJECT_ID,'')) AS COURSE_ID,
    lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS RESERVE_ID
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
  LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
    ON lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> '')
    AND lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate per department
dept_courses AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COURSE_ID
  FROM canonical_courses
  WHERE COURSE_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_ID
)
SELECT
  dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dc.COURSE_ID) AS NUM_UNIQUE_COURSES,
  -- count distinct reserved materials associated with courses of the department.
  -- If there are none in schema, this will be 0.
  COALESCE(rm.num_reserved, 0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_RESERVED_MATERIALS,
  COALESCE(instr.num_instructors, 0) AS NUM_UNIQUE_INSTRUCTORS
FROM dept_courses dc
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT RESERVE_ID) AS num_reserved
  FROM reserved_materials
  WHERE RESERVE_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
) rm
  ON rm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
LEFT JOIN (
  -- count distinct instructor identifiers per department:
  -- prefer MIT IDs where present; names will be counted as distinct identifiers otherwise.
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT INSTRUCTOR_ID) AS num_instructors
  FROM instructors
  WHERE INSTRUCTOR_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(INSTRUCTOR_ID) <> ''
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
) instr
  ON instr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
GROUP BY
  dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rm.num_reserved, instr.num_instructors
ORDER BY
  NUM_UNIQUE_COURSES DESC

WITH course_catalog_subjects_core AS (

    `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(`course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, ''),
      NULLIF(`course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`, '')
    ) AS SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
),
materials_reserved_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` AS material_id,
    td.`SUBJECT_ID` AS course_subject_id,
    tms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS reservation_status,
    -- mark as reserved if there is a matching library_reserve_matrl_detail row (presence implies reserved)
    CASE WHEN lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reservation_flag
  FROM `tip_material` tm
  JOIN `tip_detail` td
    ON td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = tm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `tip_material_status` tms

  -- detect reservation by matching tip_detail TERM_CODE+SUBJECT_ID to library_reserve_matrl_detail rows
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrm
    ON lrm.`TERM_CODE` = td.`TERM_CODE`
   AND lrm.`SUBJECT_ID` = td.`SUBJECT_ID`
  -- Only keep rows that are considered reserved per requirement (presence-based, case-insensitive if textual)
  WHERE lrm.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  COUNT(mrc.material_id) AS total_reserved_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(mrc.reservation_status, '<<UNKNOWN>>')) AS distinct_material_status_count
FROM materials_reserved_cohort mrc
JOIN course_catalog_subjects_core ccs
  ON ccs.SUBJECT_ID = mrc.course_subject_id
GROUP BY ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE
HAVING COUNT(mrc.material_id) > 0

rows.question: For each instructor, list their name, the number of unique courses they teach, the total number of material assignments, average publication year, and number of distinct status, sorted by the number of unique courses in descending order.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(ded.FULL_NAME, ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL) AS instructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(
    COALESCE(ccs.SUBJECT_CODE, ''), '|', COALESCE(ccs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '')
  )) AS unique_course_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(mat.mat_assignments), 0) AS total_material_assignments,
  -- average publication year rounded to nearest integer, NULL if no years
  NULLIF(ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(mat.pub_year, 0))), 0) AS avg_publication_year,
  COALESCE(SUM(mat.distinct_status_count), 0) AS distinct_status_count
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccs
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory ded
  ON ded.FULL_NAME = ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
-- aggregate materials by term + subject id + library course instructor key (joinable to section via subject/term)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrm.TERM_CODE,
    lrm.SUBJECT_ID,
    lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    COUNT(lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS mat_assignments,
    AVG(
      CASE WHEN lrc.CATALOG_YEAR REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN CAST(lrc.CATALOG_YEAR AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END
    ) AS pub_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE) AS distinct_status_count
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    lrm.TERM_CODE,
    lrm.SUBJECT_ID,
    lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
) AS mat
  -- join materials to course catalog rows by matching term and subject identifiers.
  -- SUBJECT_ID in mat can be the MASTER_SUBJECT_ID or concatenation of SUBJECT_CODE+SUBJECT_NUMBER in course_catalog_subject_offered,
  -- so try both matches; also match TERM_CODE to EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.
  ON mat.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
     AND (
       mat.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
       OR mat.SUBJECT_ID = CONCAT(ccs.SUBJECT_CODE, ccs.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
     )
WHERE COALESCE(ccs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, '') <> ''
GROUP BY instructor_name
ORDER BY unique_course_count DESC

rows.question: For each person role and IAP category, list the role, the category name, the number of people in this role, and the average fee, sorted by the role count in descending order.

WITH iap_fee_values_per_person AS (
  /* extract numeric fee values from drupal_course_catalog.ACTIVITY-like fields.
     The source schema doesn't have a dedicated fee column in drupal_course_catalog, so
     we also look in drupal_course_catalog.FEE-ish fields if present. The provided schema
     for drupal_course_catalog does include many text fields but not a clear FEE column.
     However iap_subject_detail has a numeric FEE column and IAP category links exist via
     IAP keys, so use iap_subject_detail joined to iap_subject_category to get category and fee.
  */
  SELECT
    isd.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    isd.TERM_CODE,
    -- use numeric FEE from iap_subject_detail (already int per schema)
    -- treat NULLs as NULL (will be excluded when averaging)
    isd.FEE
  FROM iap_subject_detail AS isd
  WHERE isd.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
person_role_lookup AS (
  -- get person key and role from iap_subject_person (person role and name live there)
  SELECT
    isp.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    isp.PERSON_ROLE,
    isp.PERSON_NAME,
    isp.PERSON_EMAIL,
    isp.PERSON_ORGANIZATION
  FROM iap_subject_person AS isp
  WHERE isp.PERSON_ROLE IS NOT NULL
),
category_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
  FROM iap_subject_category AS isc
  WHERE isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  prl.PERSON_ROLE AS role,
  cl.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT prl.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS PEOPLE_COUNT,
  -- average only over non-null numeric fees; AVG ignores NULLs
  AVG(ifv.FEE) AS AVG_FEE
FROM person_role_lookup prl
JOIN iap_fee_values_per_person ifv
  ON prl.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = ifv.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN category_lookup cl
  ON ifv.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = cl.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
-- ensure category present and person identifier present (already enforced in CTEs)
WHERE prl.PERSON_ROLE IS NOT NULL
  AND cl.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  -- exclude rows that would fail person-counting (person key null) or where fee is non-numeric:
  -- FEE in iap_subject_detail is numeric per schema; if it were text we'd parse, but here it's int
GROUP BY prl.PERSON_ROLE, cl.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY PEOPLE_COUNT DESC

rows.question: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.

    BUILDING_NAME,
    -- ensure BUILDING_COUNTER is treated as an integer when it is numeric; otherwise exclude by filtering in outer query
    CASE

      WHEN CAST(BUILDING_COUNTER AS CHAR) REGEXP '^[[:space:]]*-?[0-9]+[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST(TRIM(CAST(BUILDING_COUNTER AS CHAR)) AS SIGNED)

  )
