rows.question: For subjects offered in the summer term, list the subject titles, number of instructors, and the length of the longest instructor name.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH summer_subjects AS (
  -- gather subjects that appear in any summer term (TERM_CODE ends with 'SU')
  SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM (
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE FROM subject_offered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, SO_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE FROM drupal_course_catalog
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE FROM cis_course_catalog
    UNION ALL
    SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  ) t
  WHERE t.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
),
instructor_strings AS (
  -- collect possible instructor list strings for summer from course-catalog-like tables.
  -- Prefer term-specific summer columns if present; otherwise use general instructors columns.
  -- drupal_course_catalog: no explicit SUMMER_INSTRUCTORS column in schema, use IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM flag presence -> use FALL_INSTRUCTORS / SPRING_INSTRUCTORS fields only if they may contain instructors.
  -- cis_course_catalog has FALL_INSTRUCTORS and SPRING_INSTRUCTORS in schema; no SUMMER column -> fallback to FALL_INSTRUCTORS and SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.
  -- course_catalog_subject_offered has FALL_INSTRUCTORS and SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.
  -- Also include library/tip tables' RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME where present (single instructor strings).
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) AS instr FROM cis_course_catalog WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(FALL_INSTRUCTORS,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) AS instr FROM cis_course_catalog WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) AS instr FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(FALL_INSTRUCTORS,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) AS instr FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) AS instr FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(FALL_INSTRUCTORS,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS) AS instr FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  -- include responsible faculty name fields from subject_offered / course catalog offered tables (single names)
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instr FROM subject_offered WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instr FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,'')) <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TRIM(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS instr FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE TRIM(IFNULL(RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,'')) <> ''
),
numbers AS (
  -- helper numbers for splitting up to 20 comma/semicolon-separated names (increase if needed)
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
split_instructors AS (
  -- explode comma or semicolon separated instructor strings into one row per instructor name
  -- First normalize semicolons to commas, then split by commas.
  SELECT
    isr.SUBJECT_ID,
    TRIM(
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(REPLACE(isr.instr, ';', ','), ',', numbers.n),
        ',', -1
      )
    ) AS instructor
  FROM instructor_strings isr
  JOIN numbers ON numbers.n <= 1 + LENGTH(REPLACE(isr.instr, ';', ',')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(REPLACE(isr.instr, ';', ','), ',', ''))
  WHERE isr.instr IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(isr.instr) <> ''
),
distinct_instructors AS (
  -- deduplicate instructor names per subject and ignore empty names
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID, instructor
  FROM split_instructors
  WHERE instructor <> ''
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, instructor
)
SELECT
  ss.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(di.instructor) AS INSTRUCTOR_COUNT,
  COALESCE(MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(di.instructor)), 0) AS LONGEST_INSTRUCTOR_NAME_LENGTH
FROM summer_subjects ss
JOIN distinct_instructors di
  ON di.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE ss.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) <> ''
GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE

rows.question: For each department, list the department name, department phone number, number of students, and the length of the longest student full name in that department.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH students_clean AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(TRIM(msd.FIRST_NAME),'') AS first_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(msd.MIDDLE_NAME),'') AS middle_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(msd.LAST_NAME),'') AS last_name,
    msd.DEPARTMENT AS department_code,
    -- canonical full name: first + (if middle present then ' ' + middle) + ' ' + last
    TRIM(
      CONCAT(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(msd.FIRST_NAME),'') , ''),
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(msd.MIDDLE_NAME),'') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' ', TRIM(msd.MIDDLE_NAME)) ELSE '' END,
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(msd.LAST_NAME),'') IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' ', TRIM(msd.LAST_NAME)) ELSE '' END
      )
    ) AS canonical_full_name
  FROM mit_student_directory msd
  WHERE
    -- exclude students missing both first and last name
    NOT (
      (msd.FIRST_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(msd.FIRST_NAME) = '')
      AND
      (msd.LAST_NAME IS NULL OR TRIM(msd.LAST_NAME) = '')
    )
),
dept_phone_name AS (
  -- prefer SIS department table for department name and phone if available; sis_admin_department has phone
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    NULL AS department_phone
  FROM sis_department s

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS department_code,
    NULL AS department_name,
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,''),
      CASE WHEN COALESCE(sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE '' END,
      COALESCE(sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,'')
    ) AS department_phone
  FROM sis_admin_department sad
),
dept_agg AS (
  -- aggregate department name and phone into one row per department_code
  SELECT
    dp.department_code,
    -- pick the first non-null department_name
    MAX(dp.department_name) AS department_name,
    -- pick the first non-null department_phone
    MAX(dp.department_phone) AS department_phone
  FROM dept_phone_name dp
  GROUP BY dp.department_code
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(d.department_name, d.department_code) AS department_name,
  d.department_phone AS department_phone,
  COUNT(s.department_code) AS student_count,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(s.canonical_full_name)) AS max_full_name_length
FROM students_clean s
LEFT JOIN dept_agg d
  ON s.department_code = d.department_code
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(d.department_name, d.department_code),
  d.department_phone,
  d.department_code
HAVING COUNT(s.department_code) > 0
ORDER BY department_name ASC
